import ast
import os

def get_signature(node):
    # Reconstruct signature: name(args) -> return_type
    # args part: ast.unparse(node.args) usually includes the full arg list with defaults and type hints
    # However, we need to ensure it matches the requested format exactly.
    
    prefix = "async " if isinstance(node, ast.AsyncFunctionDef) else ""
    args_str = ast.unparse(node.args)
    
    # Check for return type
    ret_str = ""
    if node.returns:
        ret_str = f" -> {ast.unparse(node.returns)}"
    
    return f"{prefix}{node.name}({args_str}){ret_str}"

def parse_file(filepath):
    with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        tree = ast.parse(f.read())

    module_name = os.path.basename(filepath).replace(".py", "")
    items = []
    
    for node in tree.body:
        # Module level functions
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            if node.name.startswith("_"):
                continue
            doc = ast.get_docstring(node)
            doc = doc.split('\n')[0].strip() if doc else ""
            sig = get_signature(node)
            items.append(f"- `{sig}` — {doc}")
            
        # Module level classes
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
            if node.name.startswith("_"):
                continue
            doc = ast.get_docstring(node)
            doc = doc.split('\n')[0].strip() if doc else ""
            items.append(f"- `class {node.name}` — {doc}")
            
            # Class methods
            for item in node.body:
                if isinstance(item, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                    if item.name.startswith("_"): # Skip private/dunder like __init__
                        continue
                    doc_m = ast.get_docstring(item)
                    doc_m = doc_m.split('\n')[0].strip() if doc_m else ""
                    sig_m = f"{node.name}.{item.name}({ast.unparse(item.args)})"
                    if item.returns:
                        sig_m += f" -> {ast.unparse(item.returns)}"
                    items.append(f"- `{sig_m}` — {doc_m}")
                    
    return items

def main():
    paket_dir = "paket"
    # Sort files and modules to ensure predictable order
    files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(paket_dir) if f.endswith(".py")])
    
    full_content = []
    for filename in files:
        # Skip __init__.py if empty/docstring only
        if filename == "__init__.py":
            with open(os.path.join(paket_dir, filename), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                content = f.read().strip()
                if not content or content.startswith('"""') or content.startswith("'''"):
                    continue
        
        # Skip modules starting with _
        if filename.startswith("_") and filename != "__init__.py":
            continue
            
        filepath = os.path.join(paket_dir, filename)
        module_name = filename.replace(".py", "")
        
        module_items = parse_file(filepath)
        if module_items:
            full_content.append(f"## paket.{module_name}")
            full_content.extend(module_items)
            full_content.append("")

    print("\n".join(full_content))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os

def get_signature(node):

    args_str = ast.unparse(node.args)

    if node.returns:

    return f"{prefix}{node.name}({args_str}){ret_str}"

def parse_file(filepath):
    with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        tree = ast.parse(f.read())
    
    module_name = os.path.basename(filepath).replace(".py", "")
    if module_name == "__init__":
        return []

    items = []
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            if node.name.startswith("_"): continue
            doc = ast.get_docstring(node)
            doc = doc.split('\n')[0].strip() if doc else ""
            items.append(f"- `{get_signature(node)}` — {doc}")
            
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
            if node.name.startswith("_"): continue
            doc = ast.get_docstring(node)
            doc = doc.split('\n')[0].strip() if doc else ""
            items.append(f"- `class {node.name}` — {doc}")
            for item in node.body:
                if isinstance(item, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                    if item.name.startswith("_") or item.name == "__init__": continue
                    doc_m = ast.get_docstring(item)
                    doc_m = doc_m.split('\n')[0].strip() if doc_m else ""
                    sig_m = f"{node.name}.{item.name}({ast.unparse(item.args)})"
                    if item.returns: sig_m += f" -> {ast.unparse(item.returns)}"
                    items.append(f"- `{sig_m}` — {doc_m}")
    return items

def main():
    paket_dir = "paket"
    files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(paket_dir) if f.endswith(".py")])
    full_content = []
    for filename in files:
        if filename.startswith("_") and filename != "__init__.py": continue
        filepath = os.path.join(paket_dir, filename)
        if filename == "__init__.py":
            with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                if not f.read().strip() or len(f.read().split()) <= 4: continue

        module_items = parse_file(filepath)
        if module_items:
            full_content.append(f"## paket.{filename.replace('.py', '')}")
            full_content.extend(module_items)
            full_content.append("")
    
    with open("API.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(full_content))

if __name__ == "__main__":
